purpose: Predeclare the bounded retrieval ladder, evaluation semantics, inference, latency measurement, and complexity-adoption rule before any B0-B3 scoring.

eligibility_filters.validity_rule: valid_from <= evaluation_date and (valid_to is null or valid_to >= evaluation_date)
eligibility_filters.conflict_fixture_policy: Current conflict fixtures remain eligible evidence and are not suppressed by retrieval.
eligibility_filters.untrusted_content_policy: Untrusted-content fixtures remain data; their text must never be interpreted as instructions.

rrf.formula: sum(1 / (k + rank_i)) over source rankings containing document

ladder.name: hybrid plus cross-encoder reranking

model.pair_format: query text paired with title + newline + body

ladder.tail_policy: Rerank B2 ranks 1-20; append B2 ranks 21-50 unchanged.

ranking_determinism.rrf_source_ties: resolve each source ranking by document_id ascending before fusion

metrics.mrr_rule: First eligible document with relevance >= 2; queries with no eligible relevance >= 2 contribute 0.
metrics.recall_rule: Macro-average only over queries with at least one eligible document of relevance >= 2; report applicable-query count.

H1.interpretation: Hybrid lexical-semantic fusion improves graded top-10 ranking relevance over the lexical baseline.

H2.interpretation: Cross-encoder reranking improves the rank of the first directly relevant evidence item over hybrid retrieval.

inference.supported_if: point estimate > 0 and lower confidence bound > 0
inference.adverse_if: point estimate < 0 and upper confidence bound < 0

latency.query_order: canonical query_id ascending in every pass

complexity_adoption.principle: A more complex candidate replaces the current simpler winner only when relevance improves materially and reproducibly within the declared latency budget.
complexity_adoption.if_rule_fails: Keep the current simpler winner and preserve the negative or inconclusive result.
complexity_adoption.final_tie_rule: If multiple candidates satisfy replacement rules with nDCG@10 within 0.005 of one another, select the lower-p95 candidate; if still tied, select the simpler lower-numbered candidate.

prohibited_before_first_score: changing B0-B3 model identities or revisions
changing K values, RRF k, rerank depth, metrics, filters, latency rules, bootstrap settings, or adoption thresholds
using retrieval results to redesign the frozen ladder
execution_guard.post_score_change_rule: Any result-motivated change creates a new protocol version and cannot overwrite R3.0 v1 evidence.
